name: slop-skills
description: Four focused Codex skills for code cleanup, read-only review, scoped finding repair, and pull request briefs.

interface.shortDescription: Clean code, review risk, fix findings, and explain PRs.
interface.longDescription: Deslop applies behavior-preserving cleanup. Slopmeter performs a research-first, strictly read-only product review. Slop Fix verifies and repairs P-level findings that belong to the pull request without widening scope. Slop Brief explains pull requests in product language and keeps an authorized PR's managed brief current.
defaultPrompt: Use $slopmeter to review this PR without changing code.
Use $slop-fix to verify and repair the findings that belong to this pull request.
Use $slop-brief to explain this pull request and keep its managed brief current.
